notes: Representative run: four passes and one reference-text assertion failure. All-file hashes were verified unchanged before same-version Chromium isolation reproduced the original failure. The test expected question-explanation wording in the reference panel, whose existing wording already states the intended rule.

Only the expected reference text was corrected. The complete affected single test passed, then full Chromium and WebKit course runs each passed all 15 tests. No application change, timeout or assertion-threshold relaxation was used to resolve the initial failure.

Three distractor sets were subsequently refined to avoid rejecting valid emphatic does do / did leave forms by relying on an untaught non-emphatic qualification. Question count and correct answers remained unchanged. Both engines reran all 60 questions, retry behavior, four widths and short screens: six tests per engine passed. Source, change scope and versions are retained. Unchanged story, vocabulary, reference and worksheet evidence is reused by version.

All four account runs use account-test-version.json, after distractor refinement. Chromium mounts ran in parallel, one worker each. WebKit mounts ran sequentially, one worker; no other browser test runner was active then. Unit/workflow checks and builds overlapped the first WebKit account run; authenticated preview and four cover checks overlapped its second mount.
Catalog and deployment checks ran after the account matrix. Representative, isolation, corrected-assertion and refinement reruns are not added to the 66 distinct successful conditions.

The actual worksheet has four A4 pages, A/B/C/D on separate pages, 18 numbered questions, 54 writing lines and all three four-output examples. Pages were rendered and visually inspected. Physical printing remains pending.

Two real downloaded GIFs have 60 frames and 4800 ms duration. Name, title, scene and paper regions were compared across every frame; actual card, mobile long-name card and GIF frame were separately inspected.

Preview uses the existing local demonstration account with zero stars and word page 1/2. It was entered through the updated course directory without clearing data or answering questions. Four cover widths were inspected and the viewport was restored.
